The target is the cited paper's main record, not a record of the specific result.

text: The authors argue that existing debate work overlooks human rationality and judgment, and that judges' prior beliefs have not been considered when evaluating debate's effectiveness, citing [18, 31, 36]. They add that no systematic study has examined whether debate guides judges with divergent prior beliefs toward more accurate judgments than single-advisor consultancy.
